reviews.title: Max it then start over. Cool.
reviews.text:
You grind potions and gems to max Clan Tech, the clan finally feels stronger, then the timer hits zero and the whole tree resets. Nodes go back to 0. Leftover potions disappear. No refund, no reward for maxing anything. You just get to do it again.
Gems don’t even save you. You paid to have the bonus a little sooner before they wipe it. That’s it.
People aren’t quitting because they can’t keep up. They’re quitting because they did keep up and the game still threw their progress in the trash. I refused to drop any more money or time into this game.

reviews.title: Game Buys Packs On It's Own
reviews.text:
UPDATE to the below review:

Apple refunded my money. But then the game took away 800 gems that I never bought and never received. Leaving me with -334 gems in the game.

I have no idea how the game can purchase something on its own. I never receive it and then they take back what I never got.

==================

Twice now the game has purchased game packs for $25 on its own.

It’s not possible for this to do accidentally as it requires my fingerprint authorization for all purchases.

The first time it happened I did buy a single pack, but it charged me for two.

Today I wasn’t even playing the game and got an email notification that $25 had been charged.

I wrote to the developers and also asked Apple for a refund.

reviews.title: It is a 5 star level game, but it needs more detail and description.
reviews.text:
I would have rated this game 5 stars, but what bugs me the most is how they don’t describe exactly what each effect does such as attack speed, health regen, and lifesteal. We don’t know how long the default attack speed is, and we don’t know exactly what many of the effects like health regen and lifesteal do. It would be cool if there was a specific number for how often you attacked and how much you heal per each attack and how much you heal per second instead of just listed affects for each person. It will be a lot easier to figure out if you can beat someone else in a battle. Also it would be cool if instead of just a list of server power rankings, you could have a world power rankings too.

I hope these changes could be made but they will never read my review so I am just ranting into nothingness.
